race.comment: TOMMY TIE (5) has yet to transfer his good trial form to the races, but he did run his best race to date when finishing third at Eagle Farm just over 2 weeks ago when fresh up from a spell. He slides down in class, and is ready to win. IT'SALL ABOUT MARY (9) resumes from a spell, and she looked in top condition when winning a recent trial in the inner course here. A wide gate is against her, but she will still be ready to rumble. MYNEMESIS (10) makes her debut from the powerful Munce stable, and if not too green, she can make a positive start to her career. Check the market moves. CEDRELA (15) resumes from a spell, and he was heavily supported when making his debut here on Boxing Day. He is stronger now, and will be ready to rumble fresh. Follow the market in.
